title: Charlotte | Off-Shoulder Striped Two-Piece in Contrast
bodyHtml:
This fluid two-piece is designed for the woman who moves through her day with ease and confidence. The off-shoulder cut and contrasting stripes create a soft, understated elegance, whilst the wide-leg trousers flow naturally without clinging. Whether you're heading into the city for the day or packing it for a weekend getaway, this is the set that makes effortless style look intentional.

Why you'll love it

  • Off-shoulder neckline adds a touch of sophistication to every outfit
  • Soft, breathable fabric that won't cling or mark throughout the day
  • Contrasting stripes create a rare, graphic detail that stands out
  • Adjustable waist with drawstring tie for a custom fit
  • Wide-leg cut with side detailing that flatters and elongates
  • Works beautifully for casual days, travel, or dressed up with minimal jewellery
  • All-day comfort without compromising on style
